dedupe_keys.name: sites d injection de biomethane en france

description: Sites d'injection de biométhane en France is a dataset listed in GRDF open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution operator, published or maintained by GRDF. Ce jeu de données présente la liste des sites d'injection de biométhane sur le réseau de gaz de GRDF et sur les autres réseaux en France ainsi que la capacité de production de biométhane en GWh/an. Ce jeu de données est mis à jour mensuellement. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Production et stockage. Its keywords are gaz, production, gaz renouvelable, territoires, sites d'injection. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-grdf-open-data-portal.
